item.description: The raw materials market has been lively lately. Phenol prices dropped from 9,350 RMB/ton in early April to 8,700 RMB/ton by April 21—a 650 RMB decline in three weeks, roughly 7%. For bakelite mechanical parts manufacturers and procurement teams, this is significant news.

In the landscape of industrial material selection, phenolic resin mechanical parts—commonly known as bakelite parts—have maintained their irreplaceable position in critical engineering applications despite the emergence of newer polymer alternatives.

The global phenolic resin mechanical parts supplier market enters mid-2026 at a critical inflection point. Elevated feedstock costs, persistent supply chain disruptions, and intensifying demand have reshaped the competitive landscape.

As phenol prices continue their May 2026 correction, custom bakelite parts manufacturer teams face a pivotal question: how to translate raw material cost relief into competitive pricing while maintaining engineering precision.
